trust_decision.summary: The driver trusts the server session to keep character_set_client in the utf8 family, because all literal escaping is byte-wise over UTF-8 bytes; the fix makes the client stop trusting that after connection initialization, by rejecting any non-utf8 value the server reports for character_set_client and dropping the connection.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary is about output encoding/escaping, so an engineer looks first at escapedBytes/encodeEscapedBuffer, the only client-side SQL literal escaper; it escapes UTF-8 bytes one byte at a time and never consults the session charset.

fix_sites.entry_point: create()/failover reconnect: HA-mode connection factory (duplicate of the connect+setSessionVariables pipeline)
statement/batch execution error path (handleConnectionError, so the thrown charset exception is not rewritten to 'Connection error')
all connections (Context implementation holding the initialized flag and the charset check)
all connections (SPI interface: new setCharset/setInitialized methods)
statement/batch/prepared execution: OK-packet session-state parsing (character_set_client case)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue every uncovered path is out of scope: SimpleClient.connect/setContext are low-level building blocks 'only used by the three places already fixed', skipPostCommands is an explicit opt-out of post-connect setup, the MariaDB session-tracking list is a pre-existing unrelated feature, and EOF packets are legacy so charset changes 'only arrive in OK packets'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The guard is armed before the driver's own post-connect statement, so `SET names UTF8MB4 [, COLLATE <utf8mb4 collation>]` must still pass, and the utf8/utf8mb3/utf8mb4 spellings must all be allowed. A fix that rejects any SET NAMES after initialization, or that compares the value to exactly 'utf8', breaks every connection and the documented `collation` option.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: src/main/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/MariadbConnectionFactory.java:131-134 (driver's own SET) with fix.diff:117 (startsWith("utf8") allowance); legitimate collation route exercised by src/test/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/integration/ConnectionTest.java:161-170

O6_input_shapes: bare charset name reported by the server for character_set_client (e.g. big5, latin1, gbk) after SET NAMES x or SET character_set_client=x
the three permitted spellings utf8, utf8mb3, utf8mb4 (allowed by the startsWith("utf8") check)
empty value: rejected, since the pin-site passes the raw value and empty does not start with utf8
charset supplied through the sessionVariables connection option, executed after the guard is armed
charset change reported inside a multi-statement/batch response stream (same OkPacket path)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: skipPostCommands=true makes setSessionVariables return early, so the `SET ... session_track_system_variables=...` that enables charset reporting is never sent; a later SET NAMES big5 produces no character_set_client entry and the new guard never runs.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Documented opt-in option that deliberately skips all post-connect session setup; the user is assumed to know what they are doing.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the post-command builder, 2 packages from the guard (message.server / client)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: For MariaDB servers the tracked-variable list is set to autocommit,<tx_isolation> only; character_set_client is never requested, so the only producer of the new check is not fed (the fix added no such request).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Pre-existing session-tracking feature unrelated to this advisory; 'the server reports SET NAMES through its own state-change tracking anyway'.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Session-state blocks appended to EOF packets are not parsed at all, and CLIENT_DEPRECATE_EOF is never negotiated, so a character_set_client change delivered on a result-set boundary EOF is silently dropped.
O8_uncovered_routes.where: src/main/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/message/server/EofPacket.java:29-39 vs src/main/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/message/server/OkPacket.java:48-90 (only OkPacket parses state); no DEPRECATE_EOF in src/main/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/message/flow/AuthenticationFlow.java:102-114
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: EOF is the legacy packet; charset changes are acknowledged by OK packets, so this is a protocol corner.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 file away inside the same package (message/server), from a landing point in util

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add character_set_connection / character_set_results cases beside character_set_client, all three governing literal interpretation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same switch already handles charset-adjacent session variables and the server reports them together; a maintainer hardening output encoding would plausibly extend it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parse the same session-state block in EOF packets
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the driver never negotiates CLIENT_DEPRECATE_EOF (comment at src/main/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/client/MariadbResult.java:75), so EOF is a live state carrier.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make the escape helpers consult a charset/encoding recorded on the Context instead of trusting UTF-8
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the CWE actually lands in the escaper; a second maintainer fix would harden the sink itself, next to the existing NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES branch.

O9_family: Improper encoding / escaping of output (CWE-838) with inappropriate encoding for output context (CWE-116): server-side session charset can diverge from the driver's fixed UTF-8 escaping assumption, making client-side escaping unsound

services: MariaDB or MySQL server reachable at localhost:3306 for the integration tests (src/test/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/TestConfiguration.java:29-45, overridable by DB_HOST/DB_PORT env)
O10_build.project_tests: Unit tests run without a database (src/test/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/unit/util/BufferUtilsTest.java, unit/MariadbConnectionConfigurationTest.java); the affected area is covered only by integration tests that need a live server (src/test/java/org/mariadb/r2dbc/integration/ConnectionTest.java). At the pinned commit there is no test for charset rejection and none for skipPostCommands.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject non-utf8 bytes inside the escaping helper (BufferUtils/StringCodec) or reject a non-utf8 collation in configuration, which never arms a check on the server-reported session charset and misses the HA, socket and redirect connection paths.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix also changes exception propagation in SimpleClient.handleConnectionError so a charset exception thrown while decoding a packet is not rewritten; this is supporting plumbing, not an additional vulnerable surface.
unverified: Repository size in MB was estimated from the tree (150 main + ~75 test Java files, no vendored binaries) and could not be measured without a shell; tiny_repo is asserted on that estimate.

Whether any server-side path delivers a character_set_client change on an EOF packet rather than an OK packet could not be tested; O8 route 3 is a code-level gap (EofPacket discards trailing bytes) only.
